title: Detailed diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='top' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e8f8ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#a8e6ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='mid' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8fdcff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='deep' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#29b6f6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#0277bd'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- crown: top table and upper facets -->
  <polygon points='30,36 70,36 62,20 38,20' fill='url(#top)'/>
  <polygon points='30,36 38,20 16,36' fill='#c9f0ff'/>
  <polygon points='70,36 62,20 84,36' fill='#7fd4f7'/>
  <polygon points='38,20 62,20 55,14 45,14' fill='#f4fcff'/>
  <polygon points='38,20 45,14 40,10' fill='#dff6ff'/>
  <polygon points='62,20 55,14 60,10' fill='#b8ecff'/>
  <polygon points='45,14 55,14 50,7' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- girdle band -->
  <rect x='16' y='36' width='68' height='6' fill='#5fc9f5'/>

  <!-- pavilion: main lower facets -->
  <polygon points='16,42 50,90 50,42' fill='url(#mid)'/>
  <polygon points='84,42 50,90 50,42' fill='url(#deep)'/>
  <polygon points='16,42 50,90 22,42' fill='#3fb4ea'/>
  <polygon points='84,42 50,90 78,42' fill='#01579b'/>

  <!-- facet highlights -->
  <polygon points='26,42 50,82 50,42' fill='#a5e6ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <polygon points='74,42 50,82 50,42' fill='#0d6aa8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='34,42 50,68 50,42' fill='#d6f5ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='66,42 50,68 50,42' fill='#1e88c9' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- girdle facet lines -->
  <polygon points='16,42 22,42 20,36' fill='#e3f9ff'/>
  <polygon points='84,42 78,42 80,36' fill='#0288d1'/>
</svg>
